# Guilherme Grigolin

> Guilherme Grigolin is an AI engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil (UTC−3), working remotely with international teams and building AI agents legal teams can trust, and infrastructure that keeps markets liquid. Currently AI Engineer at Concurrences; finishing a B.S. in Information Systems at IFSP (Dec 2026).

Contact: guigrigolin@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/grigolin · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/grigolin/

## Experience

- **Concurrences — AI Engineer** (Apr 2026–present): legal research agent for Europe's leading antitrust publisher. RAG and multi-agent reasoning over 100,000+ publications in 20+ jurisdictions; evaluation rubrics and a production API.
- **Triad Markets — Software Engineer** (Jan–Apr 2026): Solana liquidity infrastructure and Black–Scholes pricing bots for Latin America's largest prediction market. $10M+ volume, 1,000+ daily transactions, 99.9% uptime.
- **LISS Legal Intelligence — Software Engineer** (Aug 2023–Jan 2026): LLM legal-analysis engine (LangChain) that cut manual document processing by 53%; resilient scrapers (Selenium, Scrapy) for court portals.
- **Datanis — Software Engineering Intern** (Apr–Aug 2023): Delphi REST API for boleto payments; test suites that cut production bugs by 35%.

## Education

- IFSP (Federal Institute of São Paulo) — B.S. Information Systems, 2023–Dec 2026.

## Side projects (websites Guilherme builds and runs)

- [BitcoinHub](https://bitcoinhub.com.br/): how much bitcoin you really get at each Brazilian exchange after spread, fees and withdrawal.
- [SniperDeals](https://sniperdeals.com.br/): watches the CSSBuy clearance sale and sends AI-translated finds to Telegram.
- [Surebet Brasil](https://surebet.com.br/): odds and arbitrage calculators, plus a tracker of which operators are licensed under Brazil's 2026 betting rules.

## Open source

- [PolymarketOddsConverter](https://github.com/grigolin/PolymarketOddsConverter): Chrome/Firefox extension showing Polymarket prices as decimal odds.
- [JusBrasil-Scraper](https://github.com/grigolin/JusBrasil-Scraper): scraper for JusBrasil, Brazil's largest legal records site.
- [ai-sql-agent](https://github.com/grigolin/ai-sql-agent): LangChain agent that turns plain-language questions into SQL.
